notes: Importing your history is much faster on the newer Claude models, and no longer stops with nothing to show for it. Your kit was thinking hard about each conversation before summarising it, which is not something that job needs.
Your kit's health page now shows how many chat turns you actually have, instead of always saying zero. If you were reading that as an empty kit, it never was.
If an import stalls, Retry processing now picks up where it stopped rather than starting again from the beginning.
